clips.speaker: Ralph Recto
clips.title: 外国人不能买地？：菲律宾新规，租期99年

subtitles.en: Income classification. We're now on upper middle income category country. In the last time we were there was... we got classified was a few decades back.
subtitles.zh: 收入分类上，我们现在已跻身中高收入国家行列。上一次我们达到这个水平，还是几十年前。

subtitles.en: And of course this is good for us. It reinforces investor confidence in our economy and also is confirmation that the reforms that this administration and administrations in the past have been doing are the right reforms, the right steps to improve the economy.
subtitles.zh: 这当然对我们有利，增强了市场对我们经济的信心，也印证了本届及历届政府推进的改革方向正确、步骤得当，有助于经济持续向好。

subtitles.en: We have also in the first half of the Marcos administration, we have actually come up with many reforms that are really meant to improve and make the Philippines the most conducive and accessible investment environment it has been in Philippine history.
subtitles.zh: 在马科斯政府上半段，我们推出了多项改革，旨在把菲律宾打造成历史上最具吸引力、最便利的市场准入环境。

subtitles.en: If you'll allow me, I'll name six. The first one was the CREATE MORE Act, where we give financial incentives to investors of up to 40 years: income tax holidays, reduced income taxes.
subtitles.zh: 我列举六项：第一是CREATE MORE法案，为投资者提供长达40年的财税激励，包括所得税减免等。

subtitles.en: Second, we passed the Public-Private Partnership Code. Proof of that is we privatized three airports in the Philippines in the first half of this administration: one in Luzon, one in Visayas, and one in Mindanao.
subtitles.zh: 第二，我们通过了公私合作法案。佐证是本届政府上半段已私有化三座机场，分别位于吕宋、维萨亚和棉兰老。

subtitles.en: Third is we passed the 99-year land lease act, which allows... Constitutionally, foreigners cannot own land in the Philippines, but now with the 99-year land lease act, foreigners can now lease land long-term in the Philippines, which is the gold standard in Asia: 99-year land leases.
subtitles.zh: 第三，我们通过了99年土地租赁法案。宪法规定外国人不能拥有菲律宾土地，但现在通过该法案，外国人可长期租赁土地，这堪称亚洲的黄金标准。

subtitles.en: Fourth, we also passed the Accelerated Right-of-Way Act, which is meant to speed up infrastructure projects in the Philippines. Fifth, we also passed the Mining Fiscal Regime Act, which restores predictability in the exploration and processing of critical minerals, green minerals in the Philippines.
subtitles.zh: 第四，我们通过了加速路权法案，以加快基础设施项目。第五，我们通过了矿业财政制度法案，恢复了关键矿产和绿色矿产勘探加工的可预期性。

subtitles.en: And lastly, the executive order on the green lanes for strategic investments, which is meant to streamline and fast-track investment approvals. So I think the most important message is that we've undertaken all these reforms to make the Philippines the most open and liberal investment climate it has ever been.
subtitles.zh: 最后，我们发布了战略投资绿色通道行政令，旨在简化和加速审批。最重要的信息是，我们通过这些改革，使菲律宾的市场环境达到史上最开放、最自由的水平。

clips.speaker: Ralph Recto
clips.title: 财长罕见自曝：菲律宾FDI数据，失真

subtitles.en: Well first, our investment registration approvals in 2024 and in 2025 both hit 1.9 trillion pesos. These are both record numbers in the Philippines, per year, 1.9 trillion pesos per year in 2024 and 2025.
subtitles.zh: 首先，2024年和2025年我们的注册审批额均达到1.9万亿比索，连续两年创下历史纪录。

subtitles.en: Now to go to FDIs per se, when I joined government I actually realized something. There was something wrong with our FDI numbers. So I actually went and took a look at it and I said, what is the basis of the FDI data?
subtitles.zh: 至于FDI本身，我加入政府后发现我们的FDI数据存在问题。我仔细核查后问：FDI数据的依据是什么？

subtitles.en: And the source of that data is simply one source. If money goes through the banking system, and when you take the box you check for investments, that's FDI, and that's the only category tracked as FDI. So it's a very strict definition.
subtitles.zh: 数据来源单一：只有通过银行系统、并勾选“投资”选项的资金才被计入FDI，这是非常严格的定义。

subtitles.en: So very recently, our Philippine Statistics Authority, the Bangko Central ng Pilipinas, and the Securities and Exchange Commission signed a joint memorandum agreement for them to data share, so that we can really capture the real FDI in the Philippines today.
subtitles.zh: 因此，最近菲律宾统计局、央行和证券交易委员会签署了数据共享协议，以便真实捕捉当前的FDI流入。

subtitles.en: In today's day and age, nobody really sends money across borders anymore with so much anti-money laundering rules. Most investors now send in kind. For example, if somebody's putting up a one billion dollar offshore wind project in the Philippines, you don't send one billion dollars to the Philippines and start buying stuff all over the world.
subtitles.zh: 如今，在严格的反洗钱规则下，很少有人跨境汇款。多数投资者以实物出资。例如，若有人要在菲律宾建设10亿美元的海上风电项目，他不会汇10亿美元过来再采购，而是直接运来设备。

subtitles.en: You actually send the windmill, the equipment into the Philippines as your FDI, and that does not get captured. So for me, what I'd rather take a look at is the investment registration agreements, and how much of those really become investments.
subtitles.zh: 这些设备作为FDI进入菲律宾，却未被统计。因此我更关注注册审批协议，以及其中有多少真正转化为实际投入。

clips.title: 菲律宾财长雷克托：开放多个领域，清洁能源与关键矿产成吸金热点
title_lines: 清洁能源与关键矿产成吸金热点

subtitles.en: What specific industries is open to investment? Oh, very recently in 2022, we opened several public services to foreign investors: airports, airlines, shipping, telecommunications, renewable energy, rails and subways, roads and expressways.
subtitles.zh: 哪些行业向外资开放？2022年我们开放了多项公共服务：机场、航空、航运、电信、可再生能源、铁路地铁、公路高速等。

subtitles.en: So we've liberalized a lot of the sectors in the Philippines to foreign investment, and we are very actively pursuing investments in the electronics, semiconductor space.
subtitles.zh: 我们已大幅放宽外资准入，并积极吸引电子和半导体领域的投入。

subtitles.en: We also are garnering a lot of investor interest in any form of clean energy: onshore wind, offshore wind, solar, hydro, geothermal.
subtitles.zh: 同时，各类清洁能源也吸引了大量关注：陆上风电、海上风电、光伏、水电、地热等。

subtitles.en: And third, we also are attracting a lot of investments in the critical mineral space after passing the Mining Fiscal Regime Act. You know, the Philippines is very blessed to be abundant in nickel and copper, two of the minerals that are very important in clean energy.
subtitles.zh: 第三，通过矿业财政制度法案后，关键矿产领域也吸引了大量投入。菲律宾盛产镍和铜，这两种矿产对清洁能源至关重要。

subtitles.en: So we're hoping to really push the processing of these minerals back home, so that we have value-added exports.
subtitles.zh: 我们希望推动这些矿产在国内加工，实现高附加值出口。

clips.speaker: Ralph Recto
clips.title: 减税600亿比索：靠烟酒税补？，菲律宾的算盘

subtitles.en: Well, that's our medium-term fiscal framework calls for that. First things first, we need to hit a fiscal deficit target this year of 5.4 percent, and next year we want to hit a target of 5.2 percent.
subtitles.zh: 我们的中期财政框架设定了目标：今年财政赤字率需控制在5.4%，明年目标为5.2%。

subtitles.en: So the Department of Finance is calling for an entire whole-of-government approach to exercise fiscal discipline, to focus on expenditures that have the highest multiplier effects, to focus on smart spending. It's our job to ensure that there's fiscal discipline in the way government collects and spends.
subtitles.zh: 因此，财政部倡导全政府协同，实施财政纪律，聚焦乘数效应最高的支出，实现精明支出。确保政府收支纪律是我们的职责。

subtitles.en: There's, if I'm not mistaken, there's a tax relief conversation happening, and I think you've put out your estimate. I think it's 60 billion pesos, let's call it about a billion dollars. Just your expectations around that, and do you think then you will get the revenue-generating measures that help offset what that might lead to? That's correct.
subtitles.zh: 如果我没记错，你们正在讨论减税方案，估计规模约600亿比索，约合10亿美元。您对此有何预期？是否有配套增收措施来对冲？是的。

subtitles.en: We're looking at two measures that will help people. The first one is to raise the personal income tax exemption level from 250,000 pesos a year to 350,000 pesos a year, and second is to exempt micro and small enterprises from the minimum corporate income tax.
subtitles.zh: 我们考虑两项惠民措施：一是将个人所得税起征点从每年25万比索提高到35万比索；二是对微型和小型企业免征最低企业所得税。

subtitles.en: And you're correct, the net effect of that is roughly 60 billion pesos or a billion dollars. The other side of that is we're looking at proposing several new tax measures that revolve around the sin taxes: health taxes, environmental taxes.
subtitles.zh: 您说得对，净效应约为600亿比索或10亿美元。另一方面，我们计划提出多项新税收措施，围绕罪恶税、健康税和环境税。

subtitles.en: Basically tobacco, liquor, the vice taxes. Well, the theory is it should help society avoid unhealthy choices. And it's a program that we presented to the legislature for Congress to consider. So that's right now up for them to consider.
subtitles.zh: 主要是烟草、酒类等。理论上，这有助于社会避免不健康选择。我们已将该方案提交国会审议。

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
